question: is the horizontal line through the S peak present in only one input visit of c1002 (a single-visit line is a trail)?
outcome: undecided: within the cutout the combined mosaic differs from visit o001 by at most max_abs_diff (MJy/sr), i.e. it is effectively o001 there, so the visit test cannot separate a trail from sky; needs the o001 L2 exposures (cal) at the peak
by_eye: one sharp horizontal line through the peak ending about 15 arcsec east of it (x ~ 1120 of 1281 px), with fainter parallel streaks above; not a frozen test
